capabilities: Run timed focus sessions with configurable lengths and breaks
Park stray thoughts as tasks in the daily note
Fade the interface during focus and restore it on breaks
Show and control playback in music players and Spotify
Log sessions and daily focus totals to the daily note
extras: States it makes no network requests and collects nothing; includes a disclaimer that it is not ADHD treatment. Music now-playing for apps like Spotify requires Aurora MP3 on Windows.
motivation: Made with ADHD in mind, and useful for anyone whose attention likes to drift.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run timed focus blocks with breaks, capture stray thoughts mid-work, or quiet the interface while you work.
